property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address, calling transfer(...) always results in c.transfer(...) returning true (i.e. does not revert) in the reference; the mutant that iterates one past the end can revert for some inputs (specifically when _tos.length = N and an out-of-bounds access occurs), so there exist fuzzed inputs where the mutant's transfer call fails while the reference's succeeds.
change_summary: Change the loop to use <= so when _tos.length is N the loop iterates one past end, causing an out-of-bounds access and possible revert while original would not.
